# tombatossals/chords-db#43 snapshot

`cavaquinho.json` is the generated `lib/cavaquinho.json` of
[tombatossals/chords-db#43](https://github.com/tombatossals/chords-db/pull/43)
(Hugo Rezende), byte for byte, at its head commit `0d4dff4d`.

The cavaquinho was never part of upstream v0.6.0, so this is its baseline for
`scripts/upstream-diff.ts`: every change to the contributed voicings is
explained in `data/changes.json` and listed in `UPSTREAM-DIFF.md`.

Never edit this file.
